commands.name: message_chat

invocations.purpose: send a message to a chat by its id (a latchkey resolution nudge, an update chat's reminder)
create a chat through the chat app, its first message given inline (the /assist launch)
create a chat through the chat app, its first message read from a file (the update chat)

exit_statuses.meaning: delivered or queued, or the chat was created
refused; the last stderr line is the reason
delivered, but the agent's input is blocked on a dialog; a resend would type it again
neither the chat app nor mngr knows the chat, so no later try can deliver it

commands.output: a create prints one JSON line on stdout, an object with string keys chat_id, name and display_name; a send prints nothing the app reads

commands.name: seed_welcome_chat

invocations.purpose: open the welcome chat on the conversation the app had before the workspace existed

commands.output: one JSON line on stdout, {"chat_id": <string>}; the transcript is base64 of the JSON object {"title": <string>, "turns": [{"role": "user" | "assistant", "text": <string>}]}

commands.name: collect_bug_report_diagnostics

invocations.purpose: collect the workspace logs and/or recent transcripts for a bug report

commands.output: one line of base64 on stdout, a zip archive the app stages verbatim; nothing when neither --logs nor --transcript was given

commands.name: background_tasks

invocations.purpose: list the chats waiting on background tasks (the update run probe, its dispatcher, the backup gate)

exit_statuses.meaning: listed; any other status reads as no chat busy

commands.output: with --format tsv, one line per chat: chat_id, active_agent_id, active_agent_name, is_busy ('true' or 'false'), task_count, tab-separated; with --format json, an object whose chats list holds objects with chat_id, active_agent_id, active_agent_name, is_busy and background_tasks (objects with source and pid)

commands.name: update_self

invocations.purpose: record a verdict on the running update (the dispatcher's STUCK when the update chat is gone)

exit_statuses.meaning: recorded; any other status is retried on the next tick

commands.output: nothing the app reads; the verdict lands in data/.state/update-apply/run.json

invocations.purpose: open a new chat window on the provider chooser (the sign-in prompt before an update)

exit_statuses.meaning: opened; any other status is retried while the client connects

commands.name: agent_access

invocations.purpose: mint an invite for a visiting agent
revoke a visiting agent as the workspace's owner

exit_statuses.meaning: refused; the last stderr line is {"error": <string>, "kind": "refused"}
misconfigured; the last stderr line is {"error": <string>, "kind": "misconfigured"}

commands.output: one JSON object on stdout: list has agents (objects with agent_id, name, fingerprint, scope, granter, created_at, expires_at, last_seen_at); invite has code, expires_at, scope, granter, auth_origin, is_published, instructions; revoke has revoked

required_paths.reason: the help modal's /assist launch runs only in a workspace that has the skill
the app updates only a workspace that has the skill; without it the workspace is too old to update
the update dispatcher reads its presence, beside a missing .mngr/settings.local.toml, as no provider account signed in
the app runs agent-access only where this module exists, and otherwise says the workspace predates it
the update dispatcher's cron tick reads an agent's environment through it (bash <path> env -0)
the app publishes only a workspace that has the share gateway, and otherwise says it predates sharing
the backup programs find the backup service here, and otherwise read the workspace as an older layout
